data.name: AgeJustNow
data.comment: Relative age under a minute, in the last publish and last command rows. Lower case: it follows a dash in StatusLastCommand.

data.name: AgeMinutes
data.value: {count, plural, one {for # minutt siden} other {for # minutter siden}}
data.comment: Relative age under an hour; count = whole minutes, 1 to 59. ICU plural, lower case: it follows a dash in StatusLastCommand.

data.name: AgeHours
data.value: {count, plural, one {for # time siden} other {for # timer siden}}
data.comment: Relative age under a day; count = whole hours, 1 to 23. ICU plural, lower case: it follows a dash in StatusLastCommand.

data.name: AgeDays
data.value: {count, plural, one {for # dag siden} other {for # dager siden}}
data.comment: Relative age of a day or more; count = whole days. ICU plural, lower case: it follows a dash in StatusLastCommand.

data.name: StatusNoHost
data.comment: Status value in the Connection row when no host is set. No full stop.

data.name: StatusProbing
data.comment: Status value in the Connection row while the server is being searched for. No full stop.

data.name: StatusBrokerNotSet
data.comment: Status value in the Server in use row when no host is set. No full stop.

data.name: StatusBrokerUnsettled
data.comment: Server in use row before a port and transport are known; {0} = host name.

data.name: StatusBrokerInUse
data.comment: Server in use row; {0} = host name, {1} = port number, {2} = transport name (TransportTcp or TransportWebSocket).

data.name: StatusNothingPublished
data.comment: Last publish row before anything was sent. No full stop.

data.name: StatusNothingReceived
data.comment: Last command row before any command arrived. No full stop.

data.name: StatusLastCommand
data.comment: Last command row; {0} = the command's name, {1} = its relative age (AgeJustNow or an Age plural).

data.name: TransportTcp
data.comment: Name of the plain TCP transport, in dropdowns and inside status sentences. Protocol name.

data.name: TransportWebSocket
data.comment: Name of the WebSocket transport, in dropdowns and inside status sentences. Protocol name.

data.name: StateDisabled
data.comment: Connection state while the master switch is off; status value, no full stop.

data.name: StateSearching
data.comment: Connection state while the server is being searched for; status value, no full stop.

data.name: StateConnecting
data.comment: Connection state while connecting; status value, no full stop.

data.name: StateConnected
data.comment: Connection state once connected; status value, no full stop.

data.name: StateRetrying
data.comment: Connection state while reconnecting after a lost link; status value, no full stop.

data.name: StateNotConnected
data.comment: Connection state when not connected for any other reason; status value, no full stop.

data.name: ProvenanceAutomatic
data.comment: Connection row: the endpoint in force was found automatically. May be wrapped by ProvenanceEncrypted or ProvenanceNotEncrypted.

data.name: ProvenanceManual
data.comment: Connection row: the endpoint in force was set by hand. May be wrapped by ProvenanceEncrypted or ProvenanceNotEncrypted.

data.name: ProvenanceEncrypted
data.comment: Connection row for an encrypted link; {0} = ProvenanceAutomatic or ProvenanceManual.

data.name: ProvenanceNotEncrypted
data.comment: Connection row for a clear-text link; {0} = ProvenanceAutomatic or ProvenanceManual.

data.name: ProbeSuccess
data.comment: Result under Test connection; {0} = transport name.

data.name: ProbeUnreachable
data.value: Fikk ikke kontakt med serveren over {0} — {1}.
data.comment: Result under Test connection; {0} = transport name, {1} = system error detail in English.

data.name: ProbeTimedOut
data.value: Serveren svarte ikke over {0} innen {1} sekunder.
data.comment: Result under Test connection; {0} = transport name, {1} = timeout in whole seconds (10).

data.name: ProbeAuthRejected
data.comment: Result under Test connection; {0} = transport name, {1} = server reason code text.

data.name: ProbeRejected
data.comment: Result under Test connection; {0} = transport name, {1} = server reason code text.

data.name: ProbeTlsUntrusted
data.comment: Result under Test connection; {0} = transport name, {1} = certificate error detail in English.

data.name: ProbeTlsUnsupported
data.value: Serveren godtar ikke krypterte tilkoblinger over {0} på den porten — {1}.
data.comment: Result under Test connection; {0} = transport name, {1} = error detail in English.

data.name: ProbeFailed
data.comment: Result under Test connection; {0} = transport name, {1} = error detail in English.

data.name: ClauseSuccess
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Follows an endpoint in ProgressFinished or a transport name in ReportFragment.

data.name: ClauseUnreachable
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Follows an endpoint or transport name; {0} = error detail in English.

data.name: ClauseTimedOut
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Follows an endpoint in ProgressFinished or a transport name in ReportFragment.

data.name: ClauseAuthRejected
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Follows an endpoint in ProgressFinished or a transport name in ReportFragment.

data.name: ClauseRejected
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Follows an endpoint or transport name; {0} = server reason code text.

data.name: ClauseTlsUntrusted
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Follows an endpoint or transport name; {0} = certificate error detail in English.

data.name: ClauseTlsUnsupported
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Follows an endpoint in ProgressFinished or a transport name in ReportFragment.

data.name: ClauseFailed
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Follows an endpoint or transport name; {0} = error detail in English.

data.name: ProgressEndpoint
data.comment: Endpoint inside the search progress lines; {0} = transport name, {1} = port number. Fills ProgressPort, ProgressTransport, ProgressFinished and ProgressNoAnswer.

data.name: ProgressPort
data.comment: Progress line while a port is tried; {0} = ProgressEndpoint.

data.name: ProgressTransport
data.comment: Progress line once a port opened and the server is asked; {0} = ProgressEndpoint.

data.name: ProgressFinished
data.comment: Progress line with one endpoint's verdict; {0} = ProgressEndpoint, {1} = one of the Clause texts.

data.name: ProgressNoAnswer
data.comment: Progress line for an endpoint that gave no verdict; {0} = ProgressEndpoint.

data.name: ReportNoHost
data.comment: Result under Test connection when no host is set. Full sentence.

data.name: ReportConnected
data.comment: Result under Test connection after a success; {0} = transport name, {1} = port number.

data.name: ReportNothingReached
data.comment: Result when no endpoint answered; {0} = ReportFragment texts joined by ReportFragmentJoin.

data.name: ReportFragment
data.comment: One attempt inside ReportNothingReached; {0} = transport name, {1} = one of the Clause texts.

data.name: ReportFragmentJoin
data.comment: Separator between ReportFragment texts inside ReportNothingReached. Keep the trailing space.

data.name: TestRunning
data.comment: Shown under Test connection while the test runs.

data.name: Applied
data.comment: Short confirmation beside the Apply button after settings were applied.

data.name: Saved
data.comment: Short confirmation beside the device name after it was saved.

data.name: NotApplied
data.comment: Marker on the Broker heading while edits wait for Apply.

data.name: PublishFailed
data.comment: Last publish row, in the error colour, when Publish now reached no server. No full stop.

data.name: PortOutOfRange
data.comment: Validation message under the port box; {0} = lowest port (1), {1} = highest port (65535).

data.name: PortNotANumber
data.value: Porten må være et heltall mellom {0} og {1}.
data.comment: Validation message under the port box; {0} = lowest port (1), {1} = highest port (65535).

data.name: OptionAutomatic
data.comment: Dropdown choice for port, transport and encryption, and the stand-in for an undetected value in SummaryBroker. Named in several Info texts.

data.name: PortCustom
data.comment: Port dropdown choice that opens a box to type a port. Named in InfoPort.

data.name: ToggleOn
data.comment: Toggle switch and encryption dropdown state. Fits a toggle switch.

data.name: ToggleOff
data.comment: Toggle switch and encryption dropdown state. Fits a toggle switch.

data.name: TrustSystem
data.comment: First certificate-trust dropdown choice: only certificates the operating system trusts.

data.name: TrustAcceptAny
data.comment: Second certificate-trust dropdown choice: any certificate is accepted.

data.name: TrustAcceptAnyNote
data.value: Trafikken forblir kryptert, og ingenting kontrollerer at serveren er den maskinen den gir seg ut for å være. Siste utvei for et sertifikat som ikke kan bekreftes.
data.comment: Note under the certificate-trust dropdown while TrustAcceptAny is chosen. Says which protection is dropped.

data.name: DeviceIdTitle
data.comment: Title of the change device ID dialogue.

data.name: DeviceIdConfirm
data.comment: Confirm button of the change device ID dialogue. Fits a button.

data.name: DeviceIdCancel
data.comment: Cancel button of the change device ID dialogue. Fits a button.

data.name: DeviceIdCurrent
data.comment: Line in the change device ID dialogue; {0} = the current device ID.

data.name: DeviceIdNew
data.comment: Label above the new ID box in the change device ID dialogue.

data.name: DeviceIdPreview
data.comment: Live preview under the new ID box; {0} = the ID as it will be published.

data.name: DeviceIdWarning
data.value:
Når ID-en endres, får hver entitet dette programmet publiserer nytt navn. Alt som peker på de gamle navnene slutter å virke, uten at noen feil blir meldt noe sted.
De gamle entitetene fjernes fra serveren, og den registrerte historikken deres følger ikke med til de nye.
En tom boks gir navnet som er utledet fra denne maskinen.
data.comment: Warning in the change device ID dialogue. Three paragraphs separated by blank lines; keep them.

data.name: DeviceIdAcknowledge
data.value: Forstått: alt som bruker den gamle ID-en slutter å virke, og den registrerte historikken følger ikke med
data.comment: Checkbox that must be ticked before the ID can change. No full stop.

data.name: HeadingStatus
data.comment: Section heading of the settings panel.

data.name: HeadingDevice
data.comment: Section heading of the settings panel.

data.name: HeadingBroker
data.comment: Section heading of the settings panel.

data.name: HeadingPublish
data.comment: Section heading above the publish group switches.

data.name: RowConnection
data.comment: Row label in the Status section.

data.name: RowBrokerInUse
data.comment: Row label in the Status section.

data.name: RowLastPublish
data.comment: Row label in the Status section.

data.name: RowLastCommand
data.comment: Row label in the Status section.

data.name: RowDeviceName
data.comment: Row label in the Device section.

data.name: RowDeviceId
data.comment: Row label in the Device section.

data.name: RowHost
data.comment: Row label in the Broker section: the server's host name or address.

data.name: RowPort
data.comment: Row label in the Broker section.

data.name: RowTransport
data.comment: Row label in the Broker section: TCP or WebSocket.

data.name: RowEncryption
data.comment: Row label in the Broker section.

data.name: RowCertificateTrust
data.comment: Row label in the Broker section.

data.name: RowUsername
data.comment: Row label in the Broker section.

data.name: RowPassword
data.comment: Row label in the Broker section.

data.name: RowDiscoveryPrefix
data.comment: Row label in the Broker section: the topic prefix discovery messages are published under.

data.name: RowApply
data.comment: Row label above the Apply and Test connection buttons.

data.name: ButtonApply
data.comment: Button that saves the connection fields and reconnects. Fits a button; named in InfoBroker and InfoDeviceName.

data.name: ButtonTest
data.comment: Button that tries the connection fields without saving. Fits a button; named in InfoBroker.

data.name: ButtonPublishNow
data.comment: Button that sends the current state at once. Fits a button; named in InfoLastPublish.

data.name: ButtonChangeDeviceId
data.comment: Button that opens the change device ID dialogue. Fits a button.

data.name: PlaceholderHost
data.comment: Grey example text in the empty host box; the address is an example, not a real host.

data.name: PlaceholderPort
data.comment: Grey hint in the empty custom port box: the valid range.

data.name: DescPort
data.comment: One-line description under the Port row label. Never restates the label.

data.name: DescTransport
data.value: TCP direkte, eller WebSocket gjennom en proxy.
data.comment: One-line description under the Transport row label. Never restates the label.

data.name: DescEncryption
data.comment: One-line description under the Encrypted connection row label. Never restates the label.

data.name: DescCertificateTrust
data.value: Gjelder bare når tilkoblingen er kryptert.
data.comment: One-line description under the Certificate trust row label. Never restates the label.

data.name: DescUsername
data.value: Står feltet tomt, brukes anonym tilgang.
data.comment: One-line description under the Username row label. Never addresses the reader.

data.name: DescPassword
data.value: Står feltet tomt, brukes anonym tilgang.
data.comment: One-line description under the Password row label. Never addresses the reader.

data.name: DescDiscoveryPrefix
data.value: Prefiks for discovery-topics. Endres bare for en mottaker som lytter et annet sted.
data.comment: Description under the Discovery prefix row label. Never restates the label.

data.name: DescDeviceName
data.value: Vises overalt der denne enheten dukker opp.
data.comment: One-line description under the Device name row label. Never restates the label.

data.name: DescDeviceId
data.value: Brukes i hver topic og hver entitets-ID. En endring flytter alle.
data.comment: Description under the Device ID row label. Never restates the label.

data.name: DescApply
data.value: Lagrer alle tilkoblingsfeltene over og kobler til på nytt én gang. Ingenting over gjelder før da.
data.comment: Description under the Apply these settings row label.

data.name: DescPublishSwitch
data.value: Publiserer tilstanden til dette programmet til en fjernstyringsserver.
data.comment: Default line under the master switch when the application supplies none.

data.name: TitlePublishSwitch
data.comment: Default header of the master switch card when the application supplies none.

data.name: SummaryBrokerNotSet
data.comment: Line on the closed Broker section when no host is set. No full stop.

data.name: SummaryBroker
data.comment: Line on the closed Broker section; {0} = host, {1} = port, {2} = transport, {3} = SummaryEncrypted or SummaryNotEncrypted. A value not chosen shows OptionAutomatic, or the value found followed by a drawn icon (see InfoDetectedMark).

data.name: SummaryBrokerTrustAny
data.comment: Wraps SummaryBroker when any certificate is accepted; {0} = the finished SummaryBroker line.

data.name: SummaryEncrypted
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Last part of SummaryBroker.

data.name: SummaryNotEncrypted
data.comment: Fragment, no capital and no full stop. Last part of SummaryBroker.

data.name: SummaryPublish
data.comment: Line on the closed publish section; on = groups switched on, total = groups declared. ICU arguments: a plural may be added where the language needs one.

data.name: SummaryPublishNoGroups
data.value: Ingenting å slå av eller på
data.comment: Line on the closed publish section when the application declares no group.

data.name: InfoPublishSwitch
data.value: Hovedbryteren for hele funksjonen, og den virker umiddelbart. Ingenting sendes mens den er av; når den slås av, meldes enheten frakoblet hos serveren før tilkoblingen lukkes.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the master switch, followed by ModuleVersion. Full sentences.

data.name: InfoStatus
data.value: Bare til lesing, og gjelder den aktive tilkoblingen, ikke feltene nedenfor.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Status heading. Full sentence.

data.name: InfoConnection
data.value: Hvor tilkoblingsinnstillingene som gjelder kom fra, og om den aktive forbindelsen er kryptert — en innstilling som står på Automatisk kan havne på begge.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Connection row. Automatic is OptionAutomatic.

data.name: InfoBrokerInUse
data.value: Adressen den aktive tilkoblingen bruker — de lagrede innstillingene, ikke endringer i feltene nedenfor som ikke er tatt i bruk.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Server in use row.

data.name: InfoLastPublish
data.value: Når en melding sist nådde serveren. Uendrede verdier sendes ikke på nytt, så dette står stille så lenge ingenting endres. Publiser nå sender gjeldende tilstand for gruppene som er slått på nedenfor.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Last publish row. Publish now is ButtonPublishNow.

data.name: InfoLastCommand
data.value: Den siste fjernstyringskommandoen som ble utført. En avvist kommando vises aldri her.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Last command accepted row.

data.name: InfoDevice
data.value: Slik vises denne maskinen for alt som leser entitetene: et visningsnavn, og identifikatoren hver topic bygges fra.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Device heading.

data.name: InfoDeviceName
data.value: Bare kosmetisk — ingenting annet får nytt navn. En tom boks gir navnet som er utledet fra denne maskinen, vist som plassholder. Lagres når boksen forlates, ikke ved Ta i bruk.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Device name row. Apply is ButtonApply.

data.name: InfoDeviceId
data.value: Bare små bokstaver, sifre og understreker, opptil {0} tegn. En tom verdi gir navnet som er utledet fra denne maskinen.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Device ID row; {0} = maximum length (48).

data.name: InfoBroker
data.value: Endringer her gjelder fra Ta i bruk, som oppretter tilkoblingen på nytt én gang. Alt som står på Automatisk finnes ved å prøve serveren når Test tilkoblingen eller Ta i bruk trykkes, og aldri ellers.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Broker heading. Apply, Test connection and Automatic are ButtonApply, ButtonTest and OptionAutomatic.

data.name: InfoHost
data.value: Et navn eller en adresse. En fullstendig ws://- eller wss://-adresse brukes nøyaktig som skrevet, med eventuell sti.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Host row. ws:// and wss:// are typed literally.

data.name: InfoPort
data.value: Automatisk prøver portene fjernstyringsservere vanligvis bruker, krypterte og ukrypterte, og husker den som svarte. Velg Annen… for å skrive inn en port.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Port row. Automatic and Other… are OptionAutomatic and PortCustom.

data.name: InfoTransport
data.value: Automatisk prøver TCP først, deretter WebSocket, og husker den som svarte — nyttig for en maskin som noen ganger er på det interne nettverket og andre ganger utenfor. En transport valgt manuelt brukes alltid.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Transport row. Automatic is OptionAutomatic.

data.name: InfoEncryption
data.value: Automatisk prøver hvert endepunkt kryptert først, og faller tilbake til klartekst bare der serveren ikke tilbyr kryptering i det hele tatt — et avvist passord eller et sertifikat uten tillit avslutter søket i stedet. Et valg gjort manuelt brukes alltid, og en vert skrevet som wss://-adresse er kryptert uansett hva dette står på.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Encrypted connection row. Automatic is OptionAutomatic.

data.name: InfoCertificateTrust
data.value: En server med et sertifikat den har laget selv avvises av sertifikatene denne maskinen stoler på, og det er ved å godta alle sertifikater at tilkoblingen lykkes.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Certificate trust row.

data.name: InfoUsername
data.value: Et endret brukernavn starter søket etter serverens endepunkt på nytt: en server har ofte en egen lytter per konto.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Username row.

data.name: InfoPassword
data.value: Skrives aldri til loggen, og publiseres aldri.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Password row.

data.name: InfoDiscoveryPrefix
data.value: Entitetene kunngjøres i et åpent publisert discovery-format, som noen programmer leser og andre ignorerer.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Discovery prefix row. Names no product: the format is read by more than one program.

data.name: InfoTest
data.value: Prøver verdiene i feltene over, også de som ikke er tatt i bruk ennå, over en egen midlertidig tilkobling. Ingenting lagres: verken feltene eller hvor serveren svarte. Det som står på Automatisk kan kreve flere adresser før det finnes; resultatet nevner den som svarte, og lister opp det som ble prøvd bare når ingen svarte.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the Test connection button. Automatic is OptionAutomatic.

data.name: ModuleVersion
data.comment: Last line of the master switch's info bubble; {0} = the module's version and commit.

data.name: SubjectPublishSwitch
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectPublishGroups
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectPublishGroup
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'. {0} = the group's label, supplied by the application.

data.name: SubjectStatus
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectConnection
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectLastCommand
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectDevice
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectDeviceName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectDeviceId
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectHost
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectPort
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectTransport
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectEncryption
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectCertificateTrust
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectUsername
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectPassword
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectDiscoveryPrefix
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'.

data.name: SubjectTest
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an info icon, spoken inside the Controls text 'More information about {0}'. Names the Test connection button, so it matches ButtonTest.

data.name: DeviceIdTooLong
data.value: En ID kan ha høyst {0} tegn.
data.comment: Validation message in the change device ID dialogue; {0} = maximum length (48).

data.name: DeviceIdNoAlnum
data.value: En ID må inneholde minst én bokstav eller ett siffer.
data.comment: Validation message in the change device ID dialogue.

data.name: InfoPublishGroups
data.value: Hver bryter virker med en gang. Når en gruppe slås av, merkes entitetene som utilgjengelige uten å bli fjernet, slik at navnene og områdene som er valgt for dem, beholdes.
data.comment: Info bubble text for the What to publish heading, shown when the application supplies none. Full sentences.

data.name: HeadingRemoval
data.comment: Section heading above the device-removal card, last on the panel. Shown only in applications that offer removal.

data.name: RowRemoval
data.comment: Row label of the device-removal card, under HeadingRemoval.

data.name: DescRemoval
data.value: Tømmer alt denne enheten har publisert, og slår av publiseringen.
data.comment: Description under the Published device row label. One short line: a longer one widens the whole panel. Never restates the label.

data.name: ButtonRemoveDevice
data.comment: Button on the Published device row that opens the removal confirmation. Fits a button; the ellipsis says a question follows.

data.name: RemovalTitle
data.comment: Title of the removal confirmation dialogue. A question, answered by RemovalConfirm or RemovalCancel.

data.name: RemovalWarning
data.value: Alt denne enheten har publisert, tømmes fra serveren, og publiseringen slås av slik at ingenting kunngjør den igjen. Det som leser enheten, mister navnene, entitets-ID-ene og områdene som er valgt for entitetene, og en ny kunngjøring lager nye. Dette kan ikke angres.
data.comment: Body of the removal confirmation dialogue. States what is lost before the button that loses it.

data.name: RemovalConfirm
data.comment: Confirm button of the removal confirmation dialogue. Fits a button.

data.name: RemovalCancel
data.comment: Cancel button of the removal confirmation dialogue; the default button. Fits a button.

data.name: RemovalRunning
data.comment: Status line on the Published device row while the removal runs.

data.name: RemovalDone
data.value: Enheten er fjernet fra serveren, og publiseringen er slått av.
data.comment: Status line on the Published device row after a removal. Full sentence; stays after the master switch is turned off.

data.name: RemovalNoConnection
data.value: Ingenting ble fjernet, fordi det ikke er noen aktiv tilkobling til serveren. Prøv igjen når den er tilkoblet.
data.comment: Status line on the Published device row, in the error colour, when the link was gone at the moment of removal.

data.name: RemovalFailed
data.value: Fjerningen stoppet underveis, så serveren kan fortsatt ha deler av enheten.
data.comment: Status line on the Published device row, in the error colour, when the removal failed part-way.

data.name: InfoDetectedMark
data.value: På linjen under denne overskriften betyr et lite forstørrelsesglass etter en port, transport eller kryptering at verdien ble funnet automatisk, ikke satt for hånd.
data.comment: Own paragraph after InfoBroker in the info bubble on the Broker heading. Explains the icon drawn after a found value on the closed Broker line.

data.name: NameDetectedValue
data.comment: Screen-reader name of that icon, spoken straight after the value it follows. Lower case, no full stop.
